title: A branch delete after its archive push is not re-asked by Claude Code's own auto-mode check
why: Your gripe, Oct 26: sessions keep asking "push as an archive, then delete?" when that is always the right move. c70 fixed our guard; the platform's check still asks.
note: Done Oct 27: PR 641 landed in batch #649 (main 2ad85de6, checked by triage). settings.json autoMode.allow keeps "$defaults" and adds an "Archived Branch Delete" entry; hooks/test_auto_mode_allow.py tests it; decision archived-branch-delete-allowed records it. Owner approved the settings edit by decision card, Oct 26 20:08 UTC. Port: yes, through the install. Note: the reviewer's optional tightening for merged branches (no commit since the merge) was left out, since the guard already refuses that local delete.
